steps.text: An ant bite injects formic acid into your skin, which causes the sting. Let's see how to relieve it.
Tap “Ant Bite” to see the acid cause pain.
Now tap “Apply Base” to rub on baking soda (a base).
Watch the pain fade — the base neutralises the formic acid: Acid + Base → Salt + Water + relief!
That's neutralisation in daily life — a base cancels the acid that caused the sting.
